denominator: 18 named obligation groups; unequal size, no percentage derived

statusDefinition.notStarted: No implementation of group behavior; shared schemas/codecs do not qualify
statusDefinition.completedScoped: Frozen standalone contract implemented/reviewed/tested within stated scope; explicit diagnostic/domain exceptions remain
statusDefinition.partial: Some prerequisites or helpers applied; group call path or major obligations missing

acceptance: Frozen current Rust entrypoint/call path and dirty-source authority mapped
AGY-authored implementation plus independent source/contract review
Dependency/runtime wiring preserves exact identity fences and no replay for started/unknown effects
Meaningful adversarial tests with owned fixtures and relevant source-equivalent results
Relevant Windows/native or external interface fixture checks explicitly scoped; mocks separate

excluded: Live service start/reset/termination, deployment/cutover, commits/push/remotes unauthorized
uncertainty: Initial broad Rust inventory is not an exhaustive function-by-function parity mapping; pending runtime audits can split/extend groups. Group counts and test counts are not effort/feature coverage percentages. Earlier 15–20 or20–30 estimates are superseded.
